sources.location: Kottahachchi et al., EuPA Open Proteomics 7 (2015) 43-53, DOI 10.1016/j.euprot.2015.04.001

claims.value: 26 acquisitions from five polycythemia-vera patients and five healthy volunteers; 24 SCIEX scan companions are represented as associated data files (50 deposited RAW-category files covered).
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol and deposited Sampleandfilenames.docx mapping P1-P5 and healthy sample IDs N7/N8/N10/N11/N12.
Methods specify QSTAR information-dependent acquisition selecting the two most intense precursors and Q Exactive data-dependent acquisition selecting the top ten.

limitations: The 14 N12 gel bands retain one biological source and fraction identifiers 1-14.
SCIEX .wiff.scan companions are associated data files, not independent acquisitions.
Disease and treatment are perfectly confounded: all PV patients received hydroxycarbamide, low-dose aspirin, and therapeutic venesection, while controls were untreated.
